V98_BLURBS.arboreal: A Mage can close a forest path again with 10 seconds of casting (200 mana).
V98_BLURBS.armyofdeath: Risen Dead raises 10 soldiers in a battle.
V98_BLURBS.charon: Grave Robbing gives 3 gold for every point of mana.
V98_BLURBS.clearthoughts: A 3-second cast (50 mana): every army within 3 provinces of the Mage is revealed for 20 seconds. 40-second cooldown.
V98_BLURBS.commune: Opening a forest path takes 10 seconds.
V98_BLURBS.curse1: Autocast (50 mana): when an army with a Mage starts a battle, its weapons deal +5% damage. 5-minute cooldown per army.
V98_BLURBS.curse2: Cursed Weapons deal +10% damage; cooldown 3 minutes.
V98_BLURBS.curse3: Cursed Weapons deal +15% damage; cooldown 90 seconds.
V98_BLURBS.deathtax: Grave Robbing gives 2 gold for every point of mana.
V98_BLURBS.earthquake: A Mage standing in an enemy province your army occupies can cast an Earthquake (200 mana: it needs Magic Abundance): after 30 seconds every building in that province is destroyed, and every wall on its borders takes 120 wall damage (enough to bring down any wall).
V98_BLURBS.fiery1: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Warlock starts a battle, every blow has a 5% chance to strike twice as hard.
V98_BLURBS.fiery2: Fiery Weapons: a 10% chance of a double blow.
V98_BLURBS.fiery3: Fiery Weapons: a 15% chance of a double blow.
V98_BLURBS.firetrap: A Warlock buries a fire trap in his province (3 seconds of casting, 50 mana). The next enemy army to enter any part of that province is engulfed: 150 damage that ignores armor, to its front line. One trap per Warlock.
V98_BLURBS.forest: A Mage standing in a province you own or occupy can open a path through a border of trees after 20 seconds of casting (200 mana). Lumber Mills are unaffected.
V98_BLURBS.forestspirit: A Druid channels a Forest Spirit into the province he stands in: while he keeps it up, the province makes twice the gold, wood, food and research. It drains 1 mana a second, and he regains none meanwhile.
V98_BLURBS.gelemental: A Druid summons a towering man of living water for 2 minutes (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana): 500 health, no armor, 50 damage a swing. He joins the Druid’s army (or forms one), fights, and can capture provinces. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.
V98_BLURBS.graverob: A 3-second cast that spends all of the Mage’s mana: 1 gold for every point. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.
V98_BLURBS.hallways: Opening a mountain tunnel takes 10 seconds.
V98_BLURBS.harvest: A Mage channels it for as long as he stands still: every Farm you own gives 10% more food. It drains 1 mana a second, and he regains none while channeling. One Mage casts it at a time.
V98_BLURBS.mending: A Mage heals an army’s wounds back to full over 1 minute. 25 mana, no cooldown.
V98_BLURBS.mindread: Clear Thoughts reveals every army on the map.
V98_BLURBS.necro: Risen Dead raises 7 soldiers in a battle.
V98_BLURBS.pathfire: A Warlock fires up his army (50 mana): 100% faster for 10 seconds. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.
V98_BLURBS.planar: Trading gives 1 of each resource for every point of mana.
V98_BLURBS.rift: Pick any explored province you may enter (your land, unclaimed land, or a nation you are at war or in a truce with): after 3 seconds of casting (100 mana) the Mage and his army are carried there. 2-minute cooldown for the nation.
V98_BLURBS.risen: Autocast: the first time a soldier of the army falls in a battle, the Mage spends 50 mana and the dead rise: that soldier and the next 4 to fall get straight back up, looking rather worse for it (same strength). Then it stops; when the battle ends it has a 2-minute cooldown. One Mage keeps this or Cursed Weapons ready, not both.
V98_BLURBS.rockarmor: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Druid starts a battle, plates of stone gather round it: a shield worth 10% of the army’s total health soaks up the damage before any soldier is hurt.
V98_BLURBS.sacredpyre: A Warlock standing in one of your provinces raises a Sacred Pyre there (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana and 200 wood). For 1 minute that province makes 110 more gold every 10 s. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.
V98_BLURBS.scoutpyre: A Warlock lights a pyre where he stands (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana). For 1 minute it sees every neighboring province in its line of sight. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.
V98_BLURBS.sealed: A Mage can seal a mountain tunnel again with 10 seconds of casting (200 mana).
V98_BLURBS.skin: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Mage starts a battle, its soldiers get +5% health.
V98_BLURBS.stasis: A Mage sets a trap in his province (3 seconds of casting, 50 mana); the next enemy army there can’t leave for 10 seconds (it can still fight). One trap at a time; no cooldown.
V98_BLURBS.stockmarket: Trading gives 2 of each resource for every 3 points of mana.
V98_BLURBS.terrascape: A Mage grows a line of trees along an open border, with a forest path left open in the middle: only a path through the trees remains. 5 minutes of casting, 100 mana.
V98_BLURBS.townportal: After 3 seconds of casting (100 mana), a Druid and the army he is in are carried to your capital. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.
V98_BLURBS.trading: A 3-second cast that spends all of the Mage’s mana: 1 food, 1 gold and 1 wood for every 3 points. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.
V98_BLURBS.underworld: A Mage standing in a province you own or occupy can open a tunnel through a mountain border after 20 seconds of casting (200 mana).
V98_BLURBS.wrocks: A Druid raises whispering stones on a mountain border of the province he stands in (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana): both provinces on either side are in sight for 1 minute.
